limitations: Software attestation does not establish physical-device or hardware-backed trust; Bootloader and TEE remain danger modules.
The READPROC option removes a real supplementary group and reduces visibility of other processes. Its mount result is not equivalent cross-process coverage.
ARM-only virtualization checks and the LSPosed native heap slice remain unavailable. Helper availability must be read from each original export.
Native Root retains the weak /data/local/tmp inode review. Other unrelated warning modules are retained.
Only the frozen diagnostic APKs and pinned detector versions were measured.
